items.title: Stalks of the pushforward along a closed inclusion, and the counit is an isomorphism
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: 17 行、闭包含推前的茎：x∉Z 时取不交 Z 的小邻域，空集层约定给茎 {*};z∈Z 时邻域皆 Z∩U 型，茎为 F_z；余单位映射茎上同构故为同构。承重三例都在 span 内；1 处引用（空集约定）作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-stalks-closed-pushforward (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 5152-5173

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: outside Z small neighbourhoods disjoint from Z give singleton stalks; at z in Z neighbourhoods are intersections with Z so the stalk is F_z; the canonical counit map is an isomorphism on stalks, hence an isomorphism (source lines 5175-5191)
